source: murder mystery 2 with horse maps and animals

image_prompt.text: Stalls, hay bales, feed bins and fence lines around the stables where a player can break the murderer's sightline
Large barn doors and yard gates set into the outer boundary of the map
A stable or barn at the centre with fenced paddocks of horses around it
Other farm animals in pens and sheds scattered around the map

layout_placement.text: Separated start points for the murderer and everyone else
An exit in the boundary acting as a round-win trigger

notes: Classification was forced: the murder-mystery loop is a hidden-identity round, and Survival's 1 vs All is the closest thing in the index even though it assumes the hunter is known.
'horse maps' is plural, so P4 is on the route for more than one map, but only one is described here.
Two preset options fight this game type - see preset_rejected.
